title: The 33 Vertebral Rooms — Bone, Canal, Nerve, River and Project Gate
purpose: Give each conventional vertebral element an individual room for Life & Body while keeping bony, neural, fluid, vascular and symbolic coordinate systems distinct.
master_rules: 33 is the conventional vertebral-element count: 7 cervical + 12 thoracic + 5 lumbar + 5 sacral + 4 coccygeal.
There are 31 paired spinal nerves; C8 has no corresponding C8 vertebra.
C1–C7 spinal nerves exit above same-numbered vertebrae; C8 exits C7–T1; thoracic/lumbar nerves exit below same-numbered vertebrae.
Adult spinal cord commonly ends around L1–L2, so lower rooms contain cauda-equina roots/filum and fluid spaces rather than spinal-cord tissue.
Dural/subarachnoid sac typically continues to about S2; below it, roots/filum continue but the normal CSF-filled lumbar cistern does not.
Dermatomes/myotomes are overlapping clinical root maps, not properties of vertebral bones.
Sacral/coccygeal elements remain addressable as project rooms despite adult fusion.
